mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in periods of declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 6 months signals a strong labor market, supporting consumer spending and business investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns in periods of rising PAYEMS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1200 thousand units in the latest month, it signals a strong housing market, a leading indicator of economic health, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns in months with HOUST > 1200.0 are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (index 2017=100) in the latest month, it signals a manufacturing contraction, increasing recession fears and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in months with INDPRO < 100.0 are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) are rising and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2.5%, it signals a strong consumer sector supported by accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns in periods with RSAFS rising and FEDFUNDS < 2.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.0% and industrial production (INDPRO) is above 105 (index 2017=100), it signals a strong labor market and robust manufacturing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns in periods with UNRATE < 4.0 and INDPRO > 105.0 are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 255.0), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing liquidity concerns and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in periods with CPIAUCSL > 255.0 and FEDFUNDS > 2.5% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During strong economic growth (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% year-over-year), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 thousand units signals a cooling housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic slowdown fears rise.
regime_hint: strong economic growth cooling housing market
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns in periods with GDPC1 growth > 2.0% and HOUST < 1200.0 are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.
